data: What is the highest BLEU score achieved by the ACP+SN method in the experiment?

The question asks for the highest BLEU score achieved by the ACP+SN method in the experiment. From the caption, we know that the y-axis represents the BLEU score of translations, and the x-axis indicates the time taken to translate one word on average. The figure shows two graphs comparing the BLEU scores of the NCP-SN and ACP+SN methods under two different searching settings: without self-normalization and with self-normalization.

In both graphs, the ACP+SN method is represented by the red line. Observing the graph, the highest point of the ACP+SN line appears to be around 38 on the y-axis, which corresponds to the highest BLEU score achieved by this method. Therefore, the highest BLEU score achieved by the ACP+SN method in the experiment is approximately 38.
